taskVersion.name: ves-heldout-item

parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station H-04 (survey area H). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 133.9 | 19.46 | 19.46
2 | 50.7 | 19.69 | 39.15
3 | 23.0 | 4.00 | 43.15
4 | 61.9 | 4.32 | 47.47
5 | 20.8 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this sounding curve as QHA-type.

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: H-04
Curve type: QHA
Aquifer depth: 43.15–47.47 m
Recommendation: Target the moderately resistive layer (61.9 Ω·m, 43.15–47.47 m depth) as the primary aquifer zone, likely a saturated sand/gravel horizon sandwiched between conductive clay layers; ensure casing is set through the overlying low-resistivity clay (23.0 Ω·m) to prevent borehole instability, and confirm yield with a pumping test before finalizing the screen interval.
